channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: DriveWealth brings RLUSD settlement to brokerage funding
item.description: DriveWealth will integrate RLUSD settlement in Europe before a planned U.S. rollout, aiming to keep brokerage funding moving beyond bank-wire windows.

item.title: A Single Route Can Move USDT to Mantle, With More Checks
item.description: A one-flow USDT transfer can combine a swap and a bridge, but the route still depends on your source network, fees, liquidity and the token Mantle receives.

item.title: Two routes for getting a destination token across chains
item.description: You can bridge an asset and swap after arrival, or route a cross-chain swap to the token you need; the better fit depends on fees, liquidity and route risk.

item.title: Samsung Wallet sets October launch for USDC transfers
item.description: Samsung plans late-October USDC transfers in Wallet for eligible Galaxy users, adding crypto and local-currency bank payouts across more than 60 countries.

item.title: paraswap and the cost of arriving without destination gas
item.description: ParaSwap can move ETH across chains when you lack destination gas, but the route, fee asset and first transaction you can make depend on the destination network.

item.title: South Korea approves blocks on 27 crypto sites, including KuCoin
item.description: South Korea approved blocks on 27 unregistered crypto sites, extending app curbs to the web and putting users' access to offshore balances at risk.

item.title: quickswap and the first cross-chain swap: what to weigh
item.description: For a first cross-chain swap, a single bridge-and-swap flow can reduce steps, but route choice, asset delivery and recovery still need checking before funds move.

item.title: Orca and Loopscale combine as Formation to finance frontier sectors
item.description: Orca and Loopscale have merged as Formation, pairing Solana trading with credit and vaults to finance frontier businesses while keeping both token networks in place.

item.title: New York Bars Alex Mashinsky, Sets Up to $35M in Payments
item.description: New York’s settlement bars Alex Mashinsky from crypto and sets up to $35 million in conditional payments, adding a state remedy to his federal prison sentence.

item.title: FinCEN withdraws $10,000 crypto wallet proposal
item.description: FinCEN withdrew a dormant $10,000 wallet rule proposal, ending six years of uncertainty while leaving separate crypto tax reporting rules in place.

item.title: Consensys and ClearToken target 24/7 wholesale settlement
item.description: Consensys and ClearToken will link tokenised securities to round-the-clock delivery-versus-payment settlement, while regulatory limits and clearing approval remain.

item.title: Meanwhile adds $37.5 million as bitcoin insurance expands
item.description: Meanwhile raised $37.5 million from existing investors led by Bain Capital Crypto, funding a bitcoin-denominated insurer’s expansion as it adds overseas brokers.

item.title: Sui’s Hashi sets October mainnet launch with $500M committed
item.description: Hashi will start a phased Sui mainnet rollout this month with over $500 million committed, shifting Bitcoin finance from testnet buildout toward live collateral markets.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after CLARITY Act stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six set for $1 million each, as the stalled CLARITY Act shifts attention to November.

item.title: Samsung adds Solana USDC transfers to Samsung Wallet
item.description: Samsung will add USDC transfers to Samsung Wallet for eligible US Galaxy users in late October, putting stablecoin remittances inside a familiar app.

item.title: Solana DvP targets seconds-long settlement for institutions
item.description: Solana DvP pairs tokenized assets and payments in one transaction, aiming to cut settlement from days to seconds as privacy and adoption remain open tests.

item.title: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract to close Dec. 15 after Blast
item.description: Abstract will close Dec. 15 after Igloo ended support for its consumer-focused Ethereum L2; the move follows Blast and puts user exits on a deadline.

item.title: SpookySwap puts treasury swaps beside liquidity and BOO rewards
item.description: SpookySwap gives treasury teams an AMM route for token swaps, liquidity and BOO farming, with pool depth, inventory risk and chain choice shaping the trade-off.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six $1 million commitments, as its preferred market-structure bill remains stalled in the Senate.

item.title: Moving Polygon Proceeds to an Ethereum Exchange
item.description: Moving Polygon proceeds to an Ethereum-only exchange means bridging to a wallet you control, claiming on Ethereum, then depositing the matching asset.
